about: ERROR.TYPE beyond Microsoft's table and Excel's numbers in ExcelCases' error-type (ADR-0047's note of 2026-10-10, docs/specs/exsheet-functions ticket 17): #GETTING_DATA and #CIRC! are states of a computation, given back and never numbered, and Excel's newer Error Values take the numbers the seventeenth Windows run read (SH-68). Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' ErrorTypeTests.

cases.name: ADR-0047 (2026-10-10), ADR-0049: a Formula that calls ERROR.TYPE over a waiting Linked Table waits with it
ADR-0047 (2026-10-10), ADR-0121: ERROR.TYPE never numbers a day that is not known yet
ADR-0047 (2026-10-10): a Formula that reads a cycle through ERROR.TYPE shows #CIRC!, never a number

steps.note: A Reference computed while the Formula is evaluated reaches its own cell (ADR-0124).
